editorial:
Imagine being a retired soldier who just wants a quiet life, only to get dragged into a wild race across the country with a partner who drives you crazy. That is exactly what happens here. You get a high-stakes mission to deliver medicine to a sick little girl, but a scary cartel wants that cargo for themselves. The movie feels like a giant car chase that never stops, mixing intense gunfights with some really funny banter between the two leads. It keeps you on the edge of your seat because you never know who is actually on their side and who is trying to set them up for a fall.

The action scenes are top-notch and move quickly, so you will not find yourself checking the clock. While some of the plot twists are a bit easy to guess, the chemistry between the actors makes it work. If you love movies where things go wrong every five minutes, you will have a blast. You should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the explosions clearly, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a movie night. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your shelf is a great call.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, the main character discovers his own boss was the one leaking their location to the cartel. After a massive car crash and a fistfight, he manages to take down the villain and deliver the medicine just in time. The little girl recovers, and the unlikely partners decide to start a private security firm together. It ends on a happy note with the two of them arguing over who is the better driver.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves high-speed chases and buddy-cop energy.
